entries.en: to answer, to reply
to answer; to agree
entries.notes: H 栏仅「應」一字，M 栏 tap-eng 对应「答應」，据以补足词形。

entries.en: to call and answer one another; to answer when called
entries.notes: L 栏「el oso llama」疑为「os llama（呼唤你）」之讹，H/M「相叫應」义明确。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H 栏首字残缺、M 栏 chun-cheng 无法还原对应词，L 的 desabridamente（生硬地）无从落实。

entries.zh: 差人回报；回复上司的传话（使节）
entries.en: to send back word in reply (to a superior's message or embassy)
to answer, to respond; to look after
entries.notes: L 栏 santoño 一词残缺费解，释义依 H/M「照應」定。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 栏残损且与 H「迎二年」、M「gia-gia-ni」语义不相属，疑有窜行，无法定夺。

entries.en: to answer a letter, to write back
to send a letter (off)
entries.notes: H/M 义为「送信去」，与 L「回信」略异，或为同组近义条目。

entries.en: to say yes; to promise, to consent
entries.notes: H 栏首字存疑（元/允），R 栏作 prometer，可定为允诺、应承。

entries.en: to say yes, to assent
to answer the roll call; to respond when one's name is called
entries.notes: H 栏第二字存疑，M 栏 bau 支持「卯」，L「en la lista」亦指点名册。

entries.en: to return, to give back; to restore
entries.notes: L 第二词 gayar 义不明；M 栏列 huan、heng 两读，H「還」义明确。

entries.zh: 洗门风（为家族挽回名誉、赔礼谢罪）
entries.en: to restore a family's honour; to make amends for its reputation
to shield, to defend, to cover up for
entries.notes: L 言「恢复名誉」，H/M 作「回護」，义近而未完全等同。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H 栏字存疑、M 栏中段残缺，R 栏 robar/labroniga 与 L「恢复名誉」不相属，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to revive, to come back to life
to live again, to revive
entries.notes: H 栏仅「再活」，M 栏末二音节 gi-lay 与「起來」对音不合，词尾存疑。

entries.en: to come back to life, to revive
to revive again, to come back to life
